description: The figure presents two sets of bar charts comparing model performance scores on two benchmarks, with three small panels under “MATH-500” (a–c) and three under “AIME24” (d–f), using colored/hatched bars to denote different models and test-time strategies as indicated by the legend (e.g., CoT, TTS, and specific model names). In each panel, the category axis is horizontal and shows model size labels (e.g., 3B, 405B, 1.5B, 7B, 671B, and “unk”), while the value axis is vertical with numeric tick marks on a linear scale; for MATH-500 panels the y-axis spans roughly 65 to 100 with ticks every 5, and for AIME24 panels the y-axis spans 0 to 90 with ticks every 10. In MATH-500 (a), three bars are shown: a blue hatched bar labeled 3B at 78.2, a purple bar labeled “unk” at 74.6, and a green bar labeled 405B at 71.4. In MATH-500 (b), three bars appear: a red hatched bar labeled 1.5B at 91.6, a pink bar labeled “unk” at 90.0, and a brown bar labeled “unk” at 85.5. In MATH-500 (c), three bars appear: a beige bar labeled 671B at 97.3, an orange hatched bar labeled 7B at 95.2, and a gray bar labeled “unk” at 94.8. In AIME24 (d), three bars are shown: a blue hatched bar labeled 3B at 30.0, a green bar labeled 405B at 23.3, and a purple bar labeled “unk” at 9.3. In AIME24 (e), three bars are shown: a pink bar labeled “unk” at 63.6, a red hatched bar labeled 1.5B at 63.3, and a brown bar labeled “unk” at 44.6. In AIME24 (f), three bars are shown: an orange hatched bar labeled 7B at 83.3, a beige bar labeled 671B at 79.8, and a gray bar labeled “unk” at 79.2. Across panels, bars are not arranged in an explicitly stated sorted order; each bar has its value printed above it, and several bars include small model icons inside the bar area as visual markers, but no additional annotations such as error bars are shown.
